definitions.alphabetic_token: contains at least one letter; placeholders, digits, emoji, punctuation excluded
definitions.alternation: adjacent alphabetic-token pairs with different script label
definitions.devanagari_share: devanagari alphabetic tokens / alphabetic tokens (mixed tokens not counted as devanagari)

privacy: aggregate counts only; no per-message rows, text, senders, URLs or phone numbers

reconciliation_checks.check: all == number of text messages in corpus
all: share bands sum == mixed messages
unique: share bands sum == mixed messages
no mixed_script message lacks a second script

variants.unique: first copy of each distinct masked text (sensitivity)

what_this_is: script composition (deterministic, from Unicode letter names); NOT language identification and NOT proof of code-switching
